name: @lanka-playgrounds/vue-nuxt
description: Atlas inside Nuxt: a Nitro server route that scopes an instance per request, and a payload a client component hydrates from.

scripts.//dev: The application, against the API on port 4380. Start the server first.
scripts.//build:app: NOT `build`. `pnpm verify:build` is `pnpm -r run build` and it exists to check what is PUBLISHED.
scripts.//typecheck: `nuxt prepare` first: Nuxt GENERATES the types for its auto-imports — `useFetch`, `defineNuxtConfig` and the rest — into `.nuxt/`, and without that step a typecheck reports every one of them as an unknown name. It is codegen from this project, not a network call, and it is what a Nuxt consumer runs.
